title: Darbar Sajandian Shamiyan Nu
body:
Darbar Sajandiyan Shamiyan Nu Hoi Peshi Wich Takheer Aye
<<DIVIDER>>
Poet
Amir Ali Najfi – Sialkot
<<DIVIDER>>
Soz
Qalb e Asghar – Sonu
Noha Khuwan Party
Ch Faiyaz Party Sialkot
Matami Sangat
Anjuman-e-Sipah-e-Ahl-e-Bait(AS) Sialkot
<<DIVIDER>>
Location
Chehlum Markazi Jaloos Markazi Imam Bargah
Dar-e-Batool(SA) Adda Pasroriyaan Sialkot
